title: Size the placement probe token budget to cover its prompt
goal: A role-sized placement probe returns its result instead of exhausting a total budget sized from the output limit alone
acceptance: A committed test fails first: a P3 placement run whose input tokens exceed 2 × maxOutputTokens returns its result
placementProbe bounds maxTotalTokens from the probe's input bound plus maxOutputTokens, still within the orchestration limit of 65,536
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix (test/placement-campaign.test.ts, B-131 case)
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: failing test and a budget sized from the probe input, like B-119-T01 (0.75 h actual). Not a measurement.
